title: Run-in with the New Republic Fighters
description: Zipping around Tatooine's orbit, The Mandalorian can't believe how responsive the controls of his new ship - a modified Naboo N-1 Starfighter — are. He flies close to chartered galactic starcruisers, giving a thumbs up to a young Rodian passenger. He flies so close to the cruiser that a pair of New Republic X-wings piloted by Carson Teva and Lieutenant Reed pull him over and question him, much to his chagrin. Fortunately, he makes a quick getaway.
